name: Foundation
description: The ground floor every app stands on: the core block vocabulary (layout, text, controls, forms, data, feedback, media), the top-bar, bottom-bar and chrome-less shells with their page parts, two app layouts (top bar, documentation with a sidebar), a plain base theme and three that extend it, each with its own dark mode (base; zinc, paper, ember), the icon dictionary, four capabilities and the REST connector.
